probe.text_sample: Your Page Title Newport Homeowners Association Overview Announcements Documents Board Events About Buy Newport Newport Homeowners Association Overview Announcements Documents Board Events About Buy Newport Last updated on April 2025 notice Annual Members Meeting Notice Reminder of the annual members meeting with agenda highlights and proxy information. The Annual Members Meeting will be held on Thursday, April 24 at 6:30 PM in the clubhouse. Agenda items include: Election of board directors. Review of the prior year budget and reserve funding. Open forum for homeowner questions and comments. If you cannot attend, please submit your signed proxy to the management office no later than April 22 so quorum can be met.
